title: Some and any
subtitle: Omar wants to cook his mom's maqluba
canDo: I can say what is and isn't in my kitchen.
I can use some and any.
I can understand a simple recipe.
teacherNotes: Kural basit tutulmalı: olumlu cümlede some, olumsuz ve soruda any. "Would you like some…?" istisnası 5.4'te.
Arap öğrenciler çift olumsuz kurabilir ("I don't have no…"); İngilizcede not + any.
Tarif metni emir kipini (Ünite 4.4) tekrar ettirir: Cook, Put, Add, Turn… Öğrencilere metindeki emir fiillerini buldurun.
Kültür köşesi: Arap öğrencilere maklubenin kendi ülkelerindeki hâlini, Türk öğrencilere benzer bir Türk yemeğini sorun.

sections.title: Read
sections.heading: Mom's maqluba
sections.intro: The recipe from Omar's mom, in English.
paragraphs: You need: some rice, some chicken, two eggplants, two onions, some tomatoes and some water.
Cook the chicken with the onions.
Put the chicken, the eggplants and the tomatoes in a big pot.
Put the rice on top, and add some water.
Now the fun part: turn the pot upside down on a big plate!

sections.title: Grammar: some and any
rules: Use some / any with plurals (eggs) and uncountable nouns (rice).
examples: There are some apples on the table.

support.tr: some ve any "biraz, birkaç" anlamına gelir. Olumlu cümlede some, olumsuz ve soru cümlesinde any kullanılır: There's some rice (Biraz pirinç var). There isn't any chicken (Hiç tavuk yok). Is there any milk? (Hiç süt var mı?)
support.ar: some و any بمعنى «بعض / شيء من». نستخدم some في الجملة المثبتة، و any في النفي والسؤال: There's some rice = يوجد بعض الأرزّ. There isn't any chicken = لا يوجد أيّ دجاج. Is there any milk? = هل يوجد حليب؟

tr.note: Olumsuz ve soru cümlelerinde some değil any kullan.

ar.note: بعد not استخدم any، ولا تجمع بين نفيين (not + no).
